newsitem.title: USA: PLHX to list options on AXENT, others.
newsitem.headline: PLHX to list options on AXENT, others.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) said Monday it will begin trading options on four stocks on November 13.
It said it will list options on AXENT Technologies Inc, DAKA International Inc, TETRA Technologies Inc and Watts Industries Inc.
AXENT options will have opening strike prices of 15, 17-1/2 and 20, with initial expirations in December, January, February and May.
DAKA will have opening strikes of five, 7-1/2 and 10 and initial expirations in December, January, April and July.
For TETRA, options will open with strikes of 20, 22-1/2 and 25 and expirations in December, January, March and June.
Watts options will have initial strike prices of 17-1/2, 20 and 22-1/2, with introductory expirations in December, January, March and June.

Gateway Partners will be the specialist for the TETRA and Watts options, Group One Ltd will be the specialist for DAKA options and TFM Investment Group will be the specialist for AXENT options.--Derivatives desk, (312) 408-8750
